# JEENEETARD

JEENEETARD is a free, browse-first educational library for JEE and NEET students.
It curates YouTube lessons by exam, class, subject, and chapter, and embeds the
official YouTube player instead of hosting video files.

## What this site contains

- Home and browse pages for finding courses quickly.
- Chapter pages that list free courses for the same topic side by side.
- Course pages with embedded YouTube lessons, chapter notes, and comments.
- Faculty profile pages for verified aliases and course discovery.
- A curation-methodology page that explains catalogue labels and corrections.
- Legal pages for terms and privacy.

## Public crawlable routes

- `/`
- `/browse`
- `/explore`
- `/course/:id`
- `/faculty/:slug`
- `/methodology`
- `/terms`
- `/privacy`

## Indexing and crawl guidance

- Public pages are intended to be indexed.
- `/admin` is restricted and excluded by robots rules.
- Search result URLs and capability-gated routes may be `noindex`.
- The canonical XML sitemap is `/sitemap.xml`.

## Content policy

- All videos stay on YouTube; this site stores descriptive metadata only.
- Use the canonical course page for course-level summaries.
- Use the browse and chapter pages for discovery and comparison.
- Use `/methodology` for the meaning and limits of catalogue classifications.
